title: Marius Masalar
subtitle: Brand and community strategist at 1Password by day, composer and photographer the rest of the time. Writing about healthier, more thoughtful relationships with technology.

posts.title: Passport, please: three months with the Galaxy Fold 8
posts.description: I wouldn’t replace it if it broke, but it’s the most fun I’ve had with a smartphone in a decade

posts.title: "Different interfaces are good at different things"
posts.description: Command line interfaces ask more of you up front, but allow for expressive and easy-to-automate computing over time.

posts.title: "The point of text is as much to be written as it is to be read"
posts.description: The more I do it, the more I realize the pursuit of better writing is the pursuit of a more satisfied reader. It's an act of care.
